args.thought: Steam Deck risk mitigation — path drawing latency: decouple input sampling from expensive path rebuild/render. Sample pointer/stick positions every frame into a small ring buffer (struct points, no allocations). Update the rendered path on a budget: rebuild polyline mesh/LineRenderer only every 50–80ms OR when accumulated distance since last update exceeds dMin; while drawing, do incremental append-only updates. On release, run a single finalize pass: simplify with Ramer–Douglas–Peucker, then fit a spline and bake any nav/pathfinding inputs. Rendering: prefer a preallocated dynamic mesh (or LineRenderer with pre-sized buffers) and avoid per-point instantiation; use pooled NativeList/NativeArray where possible. Performance: move simplify/finalize into Jobs + Burst on Deck CPU; keep main thread work limited to buffer append + occasional mesh update; avoid GC by pooling lists and using Input System callbacks. Add a debug overlay (ms spent sampling, rebuild frequency, vertex count) to tune budgets per device.
args.performanceConsideration: Throttle mesh rebuilds; avoid allocations; offload finalize/simplify to Jobs/Burst to keep frame times stable on Steam Deck.
alternatives: GPU-drawn ribbon via VFX Graph (if acceptable)

Sample pointer/stylus at fixed cadence (e.g., 120Hz max, clamp on low FPS), store into a pooled NativeList<float2>. On end-of-stroke (and optionally throttled every ~150ms while drawing), run Ramer–Douglas–Peucker simplification in a Burst-compiled job with epsilon scaled by camera zoom / map scale so detail is preserved when zoomed in. Build the polyline ribbon mesh from the simplified points using preallocated NativeArrays and a MeshDataArray write path (avoid per-frame GC and Mesh.Clear). Do expensive validations (self-intersection checks, grid snapping, power-line connectivity) off the hot path: schedule them after stroke end or in coarse intervals; render a provisional ribbon immediately and swap to validated path when ready. Instrument with ProfilerMarkers around sampling, simplify, mesh build; target <2ms on Deck at 60Hz; if exceeded, cap max points per stroke and degrade to lower ribbon resolution.
